subtitle: Explore metal riffs with focus on chromatic movement, palm muting techniques, and harmonic minor applications

introduction.title: The Science of Heaviness
introduction.text: Metal riffs push harmony to its darkest extremes, using dissonance, chromatic movement, and complex rhythms to create maximum emotional and physical impact. Understanding metal theory reveals how calculated musical choices create visceral reactions.

columns.title: Harmonic Tension
columns.text: Metal maximizes dissonance through tritones, chromatic movement, and avoided resolutions.

columns.title: Rhythmic Complexity
columns.text: Complex time signatures and polyrhythms create intellectual and physical challenge.

columns.title: Technical Mastery
columns.text: Extreme techniques push instruments to their limits, requiring years of dedicated practice.

steps.title: Foundation (Months 1-2)
steps.description: Master palm muting technique. Learn basic power chord progressions. Develop alternate picking precision. Study "Iron Man" and "Paranoid".

steps.title: Advanced Harmony (Months 3-6)
steps.description: Chromatic riff construction. Tremolo picking development. Harmonic minor scale application. Study Metallica and Megadeth riffs.

steps.title: Technical Mastery (Months 7-12)
steps.description: Sweep picking arpeggios. Advanced polyrhythms. Artificial harmonics mastery. Progressive and death metal study.
